how_to_read: Each call is Up or Down for the next 10 minutes, scored against the real price 10 minutes later. 50% is a coin flip. Unchanged prices and market-closed periods are not counted.

gold.statement: Live direction record: 52% of the last 31 ten-minute up/down calls were right (a coin flip is 50%; simply always guessing the more common direction would have scored 52%; with this many calls, normal luck is about +/-17 points).

oil.statement: Live direction record: 39% of the last 31 ten-minute up/down calls were right (a coin flip is 50%; simply always guessing the more common direction would have scored 68%; with this many calls, normal luck is about +/-16 points).
